description: Evaluate a proposed workflow action against deterministic policy rules stored in the policy_rules table. Returns allow, deny, or manual_review with the matched rule and rationale. When multiple rules match, the most-restrictive decision wins (deny > manual_review > allow).

action.description: Name of the action being evaluated (e.g. 'approve_remediation', 'close_finding', 'escalate_to_soc'). Used for audit log context; policy matching is done on fact_set attributes.

fact_set.description: Flat key/value map of facts about the action context. Keys are matched against policy rule predicates. Common keys: exposure ('internet-facing', 'internal-vpc'), severity ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH', etc.), tier ('tier-0'), environment ('production', 'staging'), cve_id.
